governance_note: Define state variables, units, scope, and what the controller is regulating.
Document whether modeled inputs are physically, legally, institutionally, and ethically available.
Review measurement noise, bias, delay, and incomplete observation.
Report ranks, conditioning, and unstable hidden or unreachable modes.
Check actuator saturation, state constraints, delays, rates, and input effort.
Document performance objectives, optimization weights, tradeoffs, and accountable decision authority.
Test perturbations to A, B, C, feedback gains, and initial conditions.
